subject: reasoning
question:
Three of the following four letter-clusters are alike in a certain way and one is different.

Pick the odd one out.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d16e50abe1a866069dc7ff61c99f97f83c1c43a73bc7da4d0c011f370fc1dfe.png] 

The logic followed here is :- 

 
• First and second letter - Difference between the position value according to English alphabetic series is (3).
 
• First and third letter - Opposite letter pairs according to English alphabetic series.

​So,

 
• Option - (1) : EHV

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/76ff1d6d251e3b9db96b1d624f7f636f6465c499f8d59f3c41d004a8c1216a26.png] 

 
• Option - (2) : BEY

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ebebaa1bec9da3f607a7f6cffa93e0e6261619c73cba148b4d29fe38811a16f4.png] 

 
• Option - (3) : JMP

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/29e49613b6bd18c65cc22023c5e7f5c652b27192dc9d5ec846c7e35fdba84c5f.png] 

 
• Option - (4) : GJT

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/01e3639dd00a54823475f726f8ba56eafef225014e8b93f63cf87f219e51c9ac.png] 

Thus, out of all the options 'JMP' is the odd one out as the difference between first and the third letter are not opposites.

​Hence, the correct answer is **"JMP"**.
